svg.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: The windowed-sinc FIR design recipe
svg.desc: Step 1: the ideal low-pass impulse response, a sinc function that continues in both directions. Step 2: a Blackman window over the 61 samples to keep. Step 3: their product, the windowed-sinc low-pass kernel, scaled so its taps add up to 1. Step 4: the high-pass kernel made by spectral inversion, which negates every tap and adds 1 to the centre, giving a tall spike in the middle. Step 5: the high-pass kernel's frequency response in decibels, near minus 80 dB in the stopband and flat at 0 dB above the cutoff.
svg.text: Scale the taps so they add up to 1, then spectral inversion: negate every tap and add 1 to the centre tap
